## Summary

Vellum Press Inc (policy CC-1370): theft of a laptop and docking station from a locked locker at a co-working space on Fenwick Street. Covered under clause 4.2; reserve 4,030 dollars.

## Facts

Vellum Press Inc reported the loss on 5 June 2026 under policy CC-1370 [notice of loss]. The loss was theft from a locked locker at a co-working space on Fenwick Street [notice of loss]. The items are a laptop and a docking station [police report]. The laptop was invoiced at 2,370 dollars by Beacon Office Supply [invoice 1]. The docking station was invoiced at 1,660 dollars by Crane & Sons Electronics [invoice 2]. The theft was reported to the police on 7 June 2026, reference CR/2026/4130 [police report]. The items were in a locked container at the time [police report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers loss of or damage to business contents at any other premises while in the insured's custody, caused by theft [policy]. The file records that the items were in a locked locker at the co-working space [police report].

Exclusion 7.1 does not apply. It removes cover for theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared space unless it was in a locked container or locked room, and the items were in a locked container [police report], [policy].

Exclusion 7.3 does not apply. It concerns gradual deterioration, and the loss is a theft, not deterioration [notice of loss], [policy].

Exclusion 7.5 does not apply. Theft is alleged, and it was reported to the police on 7 June 2026, two days after the notice of loss on 5 June 2026 and within seven days [notice of loss], [police report], [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted.

## Reserve

The reserve is 4,030 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (2,370 dollars and 1,660 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. Clause 9.1 deducts the 250 dollar excess only where the policy schedule applies one, and where no excess is shown in the schedule, none applies [policy]. The file contains no schedule showing an excess, so none is deducted. The schedule is not in the file and should be checked before payment.
